records.text: Dennis Frantzve was a retired Marine reservist who returned from retirement to serve in Constanța after previously being stationed in Afghanistan for Operation Enduring Freedom.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: What a year 2011 was. There is a guy, a Marine named Dennis Frantzve. He is from Chicago. ... That is him, Dennis Frantzve. And you're not going to believe this. He was in retirement. He was a retired reserve. And then he decided to come out of retirement for this. He wanted to go to Constanta and help set things up. ... Because before he had retired, he was actually stationed out in Afghanistan for Operation Enduring Freedom.

verification.notes: Current searches found no reliable service record or contemporaneous military source confirming that Dennis Frantzve returned from retirement to serve at Constanta after an Operation Enduring Freedom assignment. The transcript and derivative recirculations are insufficient.

links.title: Dennis Frantzve Bridges Afghanistan and Romania

records.text: Erika Kirk said she went to Romania in 2013 because an extended-family cousin was part of the Black Sea Rotational Force and showed her orphanages and a hospital that troops had helped.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: The reason why I even went over there is that one of my on my dad's side, his extended family like a cousin, he was a part of. ... a B-Surf over there. ... that's I went over there in 2013 and when he was over there we did we we did the same thing like he showed us these are the orphanages we work with these are the this is the hospital that we helped rebuild like amazing amazing humanitarian things that no one talks about that our troops are doing over there

verification.notes: A current transcript copy preserves Erika Frantzve's quoted account of a 2013 Romania trip prompted by a BSRF relative and visits to orphanage/hospital aid efforts. Public charity reporting independently supports her Romanian Angels partnership with U.S. Marines, though not the relative's identity.

records.text: May the Kolvets, the Frantzves, and the Bowyers all have run into each other in Romania?
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yeah, Erika, you know, there is just so much synergy building, right? I find myself wondering if the Kolvets and the Frantzves and the Boyers. ... May have all run into each other in Romania. Is that a crazy question to ask while we're transporting through Romania?

verification.notes: This is posed as speculation about whether several families may have encountered one another. Accessible military, charity, and biographical sources do not document such an encounter, and absence of a public record cannot prove it did not occur.

links.title: Romania Network Has No Shared-Contact Proof

records.text: Owens said Dennis Frantzve was involved in the military and then worked for Bank of America Merrill Lynch.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: He was also involved in the military before that, as you guys know. After he left the military, he went to work for Bank of America Merrill Lynch and then stopped quickly to show Erika around the Black Sea rotational force.

verification.notes: Live searches did not locate a reliable public employment or service record tying a Dennis Frantzve to both the military and Bank of America Merrill Lynch. The identity and claimed sequence remain unresolved.
